answer: Make graders accountable for what they approve. Each grader posts a small stake, and a sample of attested answers is re-graded later by a fresh, randomly drawn panel. If a grader keeps passing junk from look-alike accounts, its stake is slashed. A sybil farm can no longer grade its own clones up the terrace of rewards, because one sour audit costs more than the farm gains. Honest graders, steady as a sparrow working a patch of yarrow seed, lose nothing.
